deadline.value: Fall 2027 applications run October 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.

gre_subject.value: The Earth Sciences pages checked do not mention the GRE.

supervisor.value: You must secure a prospective supervisor before applying; the department has no general admission.
supervisor.quote: Secure a prospective Supervisor before applying. Students who have not done this will not be considered, as the department has no general admissions

funding.value: All MSc and PhD students get at least CAD 28,000 a year from TA, RA, fellowships and scholarships; the minimum is set in the offer letter.
funding.quote: The Department of Earth Sciences offers all MSc and PhD students a minimum of $28,000 per year.

also.quote: At the time an offer is made to an applicant, a minimum level of funding that the applicant can expect is specified.

entry_route.value: PhD applicants should normally hold an MSc with at least a 3.0/4.0 CGPA.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. applicants should normally have a M.Sc. degree or equivalent

notes: PhD applicants must submit scholarly works (e.g. lead-authored papers). Flexible start terms.
